brief:
Settlers committed 52 assaults and violations across the West Bank and East Jerusalem between October 8–10, the Palestinian Information Center reported. The attacks wounded at least 16 Palestinians, according to the monitoring group's count.

The incidents occurred during a 72-hour period, Shehab Wire reported. The center's tally did not include additional cases of damage or other violations documented during the same timeframe.

title: Settlers carry out 52 attacks in West Bank over three days
